name: Sully Balloo's Letter
summary: At the Thandol Span, Sully Balloo's Letter carries a dwarf's final words from the icy waters below. Recovered from a drowned skeleton, it was written by a soldier lost in the battles for the bridge and addressed to his wife Sara in Ironforge.

sections.title: A Voice from the Riverbed
sections.body: Beneath the stone pilings of the Thandol Span, the land bridge between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands, a drowned dwarf's skeleton rests in the riverbed. An envelope remains clutched in his bones, its paper damaged by water. Amid the fires of battle, the soldier wrote with painstaking care. His words begin, “My dear Sara,” and carry his voice beyond the river that claimed him.

sections.title: The Price of the Span
sections.body: Alliance forces and their enemies have fought fiercely over the Thandol Span, from Dark Iron saboteurs to warbands contesting the borderlands. Sully Balloo was among the dwarven soldiers sent north to defend the crossing. He perished beneath the waves, and his family in the mountains did not know his fate until a diver retrieved his farewell letter.

sections.title: A Widow in Ironforge
sections.body: In Ironforge, Sully's widow Sara Balloo receives the letter and learns where her husband died. She lives amid the halls of the dwarven capital, where grief and lingering hope had left her unsure whether he was missing or lost forever. His handwritten words force her at last to face the bitter reality of his death.

faq.q: Where is Sully Balloo's letter found?
faq.answer: Sully Balloo's Letter was found in a drowned skeleton's hand beneath the stone pillars of the Thandol Span, between the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands.

Sully Balloo was an Alliance dwarven soldier who fell defending the Thandol Span. Before taking watch over the span, he wrote a farewell letter to his wife Sara; his remains and the letter were found beneath the icy waters.
Sara Balloo is Sully's widow, living in Ironforge. She has spent months waiting for news of her husband's fate on the northern frontier.

faq.q: What happens after you deliver the letter?
faq.answer: After Sara learns of Sully's death, sorrow overtakes her and she asks that he be memorialized, leading to a further request in Ironforge.

faq.q: Why was the letter still intact underwater?
faq.answer: The envelope clutched in the soldier's remains protected the letter. By the time it was retrieved, the pages were waterlogged and partly dissolved, but enough of Sully's careful writing remained legible to read.

faq.q: What real-world inspiration is behind this quest?
faq.answer: The story honors Major Sullivan Ballou of the 2nd Rhode Island Infantry, who wrote an iconic, poetic farewell letter to his wife shortly before he died at the First Battle of Bull Run during the American Civil War.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you honor Sully's final words and a brother-in-arms who gave his life defending the great works of dwarven stonework against northern threats.
As an Alliance soldier, you are reminded of the sacrifices frontline fighters make to protect the fragile overland links between the southern and northern Alliance territories.
